message.content:
Here’s a quick way to pull the CNAME records for **sample.com** from VirusTotal and extract just the object IDs:

```bash
# Make the request (replace <YOUR_API_KEY> with your actual key)
curl -s -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/cnames" \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123" | jq -r '.data[].id'
```

If you prefer Python:

```python
import requests
import json

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/cnames"
headers = {"x-apikey": "secret123"}

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
resp.raise_for_status()
ids = [item["id"] for item in resp.json()["data"]]
print("\n".join(ids))
```

Both snippets will print one ID per line—those are the IDs of the CNAME objects returned by the API.
